description_en: Queries the list of users bound to a specified device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定设备所绑定的用户列表
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual list-binding-account-by-device --page-size 5 --product-key a1Bw000000 --device-name Device01 --iot-id C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWCg40000 --page-no 1 --owned 0 --api-version 2023-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBindingAccountByDevice

parameters.help_en: The number of records to display on each page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the video device belongs.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备所属产品的ProductKey。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the video device.

<notice>If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备名称。

<notice>如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the video device.
<notice>
IotId is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备ID。
<notice>
IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The page number to display in the returned results. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en:
The binding type between the user and the device.

0: shared user.
1: administrator user.
If this parameter is not specified, all users are queried
parameters.help_zh:
用户和设备绑定类型。

0：表示分享用户。
1：表示管理员用户。
不传则查询所有用户
parameters.name: owned

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful

BindTime.description_en: The time when the device was bound to the user. The value is a 13-digit timestamp in milliseconds
BindTime.description_zh: 设备绑定用户的时间，13位毫秒级时间戳

IdentityAlias.description_en: The display name of the user

IdentityId.description_en: The identity ID of the user

PageSize.description_en: The number of records displayed on each page

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
